verdict.rationale: Gitea's own site says it will "sync seamlessly" with Slack, Discord, MS Teams, Lark and more (gitea-docs-8). It also offers webhooks for building custom workflows (gitea-docs-4), which covers the core of pushing repository activity into chat tools. Both are short marketing lines with no detailed setup documentation, and the community remark about not bundling chat concerns a built-in chat product, not integrations. Missing for 10: detailed docs on which notification and activity events are sent and how each chat integration is configured, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the chat sync works.
